title: Bear River RV Park

services.name: The Campground
services.desc: At Bear River RV Resort you are wrapped in the finest scenery on the North American Continent. Located at the head waters of the Portland Canal, and close to downtown Stewart, B.C., you can explore this off-shoot historic Klondike gold rush town that once boasted a population of 12,000. Nearby, only three miles away, you’ll find Hyder, Alaska. Glacier capped mountains 7,000 feet, hiking trails that give you access to even the most remote areas. Navigate forests of the giant Sitka Spruce and relax with the ocean right at your feet. There is ample opportunity to view wildlife, bears and eagles feeding on salmon. Good fishing is also available so come and visit and stay

blurb: Located along the Bear River in Stewart, B.C. our campground offers full service camp sites and beautifully manicured dry/tenting areas surrounded by ice capped mountains, glaciers.
